blurb:
Take the wheel and experience the Las Vegas Strip like never before. Cruise past the world’s most famous resorts, glowing neon lights, and legendary landmarks in a stylish, open-air electric vehicle built for sightseeing.

Feel the energy of Vegas all around you as you roll down the Strip, stop for photos, and enjoy unbeatable views of the city’s most iconic sights — from luxury casinos to nonstop entertainment.

Perfect for couples and small groups, this self-drive adventure puts you in control of your route, your pace, and your experience, creating unforgettable memories in the heart of Las Vegas.

All vehicles seat two, feature built-in Bluetooth speakers for your favorite music, and offer comfort upgrades including seat warmers and heated hand grips.

Drivers must be 21+.
IMPORTANT: IF BOOKING MORE THAN ONE VEHICLE, PLEASE MAKE SEPARATE RESERVATIONS.
